notes.title: Miss Paint Demo Update 8/17/2024
notes.content:
Patch notes!
- Deleting your save file now doesn't delete your settings preferences or close your game
- The settings and inbox desktop icons got changed
- Making an edit in a level is less laggy
- F11 key is now a dedicated fullscreen/window mode button
- Fixed a bug where pressing R to reset a level while light green is growing, it would leave some light green behind
- Fixed bug where Miss Paint would stay red if you exited a level while she was red
- Made the level dropdown options say R to reset instead of Hold R
- Fixed bug with emails not loading correctly
- Fixed bug where upon resetting while making a selection, the selection would still be visible once reset

notes.title: Miss Paint Demo Update 8/16/2024
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- Added an option to delete your save data
- Made pressing R key to reset tap instead of hold
- Fixed undo and reset buttons being offset in the final level
- Fixed crashing issues with having multiple folders open
- Fixed bug where pressing reset after beating the final level it creates multiple of Miss Paint
- Polished emails
- added Clankk to art credits
